effect.divinerpg.seng_fur.description: Increases melee damage, whilst also reducing overall damage taken; refills hunger (but not saturation). This effect is exclusive to Iceika.
message.livestock.travel: When travelling, I met a merchant named Zelus, who sold me the eggs that grew into the pets I breed now.
message.wreck.run: You should run whilst you still have the chance to live.
book.divinerpg.entry.getting_started.aye: The Ayeraco Horde has 6 mini-bosses that can only be summoned in the end using the horde horn. The red Ayeraco will heal the other Ayeraco when its health is half. The Green Ayeraco makes the other Ayeraco immune to arrows below half health. The Blue Ayeraco speeds up the others whilst below half health.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.eden_porta: To open a rift to Eden, throw a Divine Stone into fire. Right-click the resulting Divine Flame with a Frozen Clock calibrated to midday. Once inside Eden, build a portal frame using Eden Blocks and activate it with the same clock. Souls and fragments can be collected whilst exploring Eden.
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.wildwood_p: To open a temporary rift to Wildwood, throw a Eden Heart into Divine Flame. Then, use a Frozen Clock calibrated to early afternoon to activate the rift. Once inside, build a portal frame using Wildwood Blocks and activate it with the same clock. Souls and fragments can be collected whilst exploring Wildwood, and hearts are dropped from the $(l:divinerpg:twilight/twilight_bosses#sunstorm)Sunstorm$(/l).
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.apalachia_: To open a temporary rift to Apalachia, throw a Wildwood Heart into Wild Flame. Then, use a Frozen Clock calibrated to late afternoon to activate the rift. Once inside, build a portal frame using Apalachia Blocks and activate it with the same clock. Souls and fragments can be collected whilst exploring Apalachia, and hearts are dropped from the $(l:divinerpg:twilight/twilight_bosses#termasect)Termasect$(/l).
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.skythern_p: To open a temporary rift to Skythern, throw an Apalachia Heart into Enchanted Flame. Then, use a Frozen Clock calibrated to sunset to activate the rift. Once inside, build a portal frame using Skythern Blocks and activate it with the same clock. Souls and fragments can be collected whilst exploring Skythern, and hearts are dropped from the $(l:divinerpg:twilight/twilight_bosses#archer)Eternal Archer$(/l).
book.divinerpg.entry.twilight.mortum_por: To open a temporary rift to Mortum, throw an Skythern Heart into Sky Fire. Then, use a Frozen Clock calibrated to midnight to activate the rift. Once inside, build a portal frame using Mortum Blocks and activate it with the same clock. Souls and fragments can be collected whilst exploring Mortum, and hearts are dropped from the $(l:divinerpg:twilight/twilight_bosses#cori)Experienced Cori$(/l).
